🎂 JAMIE LEE CURTIS TURNS 68 🎂
Jamie Lee Curtis was born on November 22, 1958 — 68 years ago today — and Laurie Strode is the original final girl.
To mark her 68th birthday, we're spotlighting a fan edit from the collection: Halloween (1978) - 35mm Scan - Fan Edit.
The original Halloween, from a 35mm scan — Michael Myers, Haddonfield, October 31.
DM us for the link — THE WORLD'S LARGEST FAN EDIT COLLECTION.
@jamieleecurtis
